fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami municipal governance, calling for a capable city manager and discussing public-utility and transportation franchises, harbor administration, and municipal docks. Coverage highlights Miami’s promotion as a convention city (including Lions and prospective Shriners/Elks conventions) and argues for construction of a downtown auditorium with proposed sites such as Bayfront Park. Additional content includes society/column items, humor and satire (including recurring “Greeby” pieces), and notices/advertisements; legal notices include a master’s sale/foreclosure notice in Dade County.
